title: Persona Store
description: Import complete persona repositories (profile/appearance/meme packs/config), check for updates, and uninstall
installFromUrlDesc: Enter the Git URL of a persona bundle repository. The repo must follow the fixed structure (manifest/persona doc); incomplete repos fail to import.
urlProtocolInvalid: URL must start with http(s)://, ssh:// or git@

allPersonasUpdated: All installed personas are up to date
